title: Speaking Assessment
description: Structured 4-part speaking assessment: interview, individual task, interaction and follow-up. Produces a continuous CEFR level with traceable evidence.

parts.title: Interview
parts.prompt: Introduce yourself and talk about your daily routine: your name, where you live, what you do, and one thing you enjoy about your routine.

parts.title: Individual task
parts.prompt: Describe a place you know well (your city, your neighbourhood, or a place you visited) and explain what you like about it and why.

parts.title: Interaction
parts.prompt: You are in a restaurant and the waiter has brought you the wrong order. Politely explain the problem, ask for a solution and respond naturally to what the waiter says.

parts.title: Follow-up
parts.prompt: Some people think learning a language is easier online than in a classroom. Give your opinion, support it with reasons and respond to a possible counter-argument.
